the Netherlands

Type: DI-5000 The maximum number of verification scale intervals will be: n ≤ 3000 for class (III) instruments or; n ≤ 1000 for class (IIII) instruments. Applied error fraction pi: 0,5; Minimum input impedance: 300 Ω; Maximum input impedance: 1050 Ω; Signal voltage per verification scale interval ≥ 1,67 µV; Temperature range -10°C / +40°C.
